title: Claudio Valente quits his job and vanishes

tellings.quote: One day in 2013, Valente reported to work. He declared it would be his last day.

plain: One day in 2013 a man named Claudio Valente is said to have reported to work in Portugal, at a place the record calls SAPO, announced it would be his last day, and then vanished. Michels tells this in an episode about scientists who go missing, drawing on a source named Sergio Bastos. He tells it as one of a set of puzzling disappearances among people with technical work.
